description: Rb₃NaMg(WO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Rb sites. In the first Rb site, Rb is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both Rb-O bond lengths are 2.98 Å. In the second Rb site, Rb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 2.71-3.21 Å. Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Mg-O bond lengths are 2.00 Å. W is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.97 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Mg, and one W atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Rb and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and one W atom.
